o1: Enables guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor activity. Involved in asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; mitotic cytokinesis; regulation of actin filament-based process; and regulation of the actomyosin contractile ring assembly. Is located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including P3.p hermaphrodite; germ line; hermaphrodite gonad; neuroblasts; and somatic gonad precursor. Predicted to interact with RHO-1. Orthologous to human ECT2 (epithelial cell transforming 2).
